note: Lane waves of the 6.88g map. The wave rules are lanes.lua (the sim has no wave primitive): one spawn timer per lane spawner, composition, siege cadence, barracks upgrades and the 450 s stat upgrades. The six lane_spawner units only host those timers and stand at the melee spawn rect centre of their lane and side (war3map.j Rect literals 100207-100219, converted with convert-688g-map.mjs toMilli). They carry no ability.

The 450 s creep upgrades (war3map.j JTE raises R003, R007-R00D one level for each side every 450 s; ratx and rhpx are the damage and health per level in upgrade.ini). Each research is one stat step; lanes.lua applies them per unit with game.apply_research. The unit named is only the research's nominal building.
